description_en: Deletes the SSL certificate of a specified domain name. This operation is intended for API providers. If the SSL certificate does not exist, a success response is still returned. If the specified API group does not exist, the InvalidGroupId.NotFound error is returned. Access over HTTPS is not supported after the SSL certificate is deleted. Exercise caution when using this API operation
description_zh:
删除指定域名的SSL证书。

此功能面向API提供者。
删除不存在的SSL证书，会返回成功。
指定的分组不存在，会报错：InvalidGroupId.NotFound。
删除SSL证书后，将不能支持HTTPS访问，请谨慎操作
kebab_example: aliyun cloudapi delete-domain-certificate --group-id 927d50c0f2e54b359919923d908bb015 --domain-name api.demo.com --certificate-id c621720d1eb34843822b7fb5148e6926 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDomainCertificate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API group. This ID is generated by the system and globally unique
parameters.help_zh: API分组 ID，系统生成，全局唯一
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SSL certificate that you want to delete. The ID is automatically generated by the system and globally unique
parameters.help_zh: SSL证书ID，系统自动生成的SSL证书的唯一标识
parameters.name: certificate_id
